name: lc-imported-services-vat
description: Saint Lucia VAT on imported services reference checked for 2026. Covers recipient liability, the distinction between registered and unregistered recipients, local branches, the import declaration, statutory payment timing and standard-rate arithmetic on an established taxable value. Use for overseas service purchases, reverse-charge questions, foreign consultants or VAT obligations below the ordinary registration threshold. It does not establish withholding tax, treaty relief, every place-of-supply rule, related-party valuation or automatic input deduction. The 2023 revised statutory text supplies the cited rules; subsequent amendments and detailed filing mechanics require independent review.
